text:
maya: quick heads-up — we need to rebalance enablement office-hours for the next two weeks. NexaHealth is targeting go-live and wants an APAC-friendly workshop plus a renewal touchpoint next month. Who can cover an evening APAC slot?

jess: I can take Tue 13:30 UTC (21:30 SGT) — 45m walk-through + Q&A.

liam: I can swap Mon morning EMEA coverage if that helps. What other UTC candidates are on the table?

maya: Candidates: Tue 13:30 UTC (EMEA/APAC overlap), Thu 22:00 UTC (APAC prime), Fri 15:00 UTC (Americas-friendly). Quick emoji poll: react :one: for Tue 13:30, :two: for Thu 22:00, :three: for Fri 15:00.

olivia: OOO Tue, can do Thu 22:00 — marking :two:.

sahil: I'll take Fri 15:00. Also recommend we include a short runbook snippet and renewal checklist in the agenda for NexaHealth. Draft agenda below.

sahil: ```
Agenda (45m):
- 00-05m: Intros & success criteria
- 05-20m: Migration checklist + routing policy walkthrough
- 20-35m: Live demo: dedicated->hosted fallback and autoscaling settings
- 35-40m: Renewal health signals & metrics we'll surface
- 40-45m: Q&A + next steps / doc links
Runbook note: canary -> staggered rollouts -> fallback to smaller model variant on capacity alerts.
```

jess: Great. Add a note to capture "renewal metrics we'll surface" so AE has what they need.

maya: I'll update the calendar and send invites. Calendar link: https://cal.company.com/event?eid=nexa-1723. cs-bot, schedule signup reminder 24h before please.

cs-bot: Reminder scheduled: signup closes in 24 hours. :alarm_clock: 

liam: Who owns feedback capture / post-session follow-up? I can collate notes if someone posts a template.

maya: Assigning liam to feedback capture. Use template: 1) top 3 friction points, 2) feature asks, 3) renewal risk (yes/no + reason), 4) next steps + owners. Ping me for prompt examples to extract action items from recording.

jess: I'll add a short intro deck and recording consent blurb to the event.

olivia: Thanks everyone. Will confirm once calendar updated. :white_check_mark:
